Umbraveil is a [[Lightning]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sonarbat]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Umbraveil has overcome fear completely and emerged as the graceful lord of the night. When soaring in the skies, those sound waves can even sunder space itself. There's no need to hide under the cover of night now, for Umbraveil's fearsome powers have far surpassed even the one who was once revered."

Umbraveil is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Umbraveil was added to the game on 7/1/2026 alongside [[Glowfly]] and [[Hierotyrus]].
